fusions.name: Twist the Barb
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A barbed strike deals 9 damage, slows the target by 25% for 2 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagging Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a fan of barbed lines through a cone ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything within 4 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Barbed Dragline
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed line 5 tiles long ahead of you for 4 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagged Close
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your armour rises by 12%.
